caption:
The best mountain biking in Costa Rica isn't found on mapped roads, but on the ancient agricultural tracks that cut through the highlands. I have spent years scouting these corridors for My Adventure Costa Rica, where the dirt transitions from red clay to volcanic gravel under your tires. When you ride these routes, you are sharing the path with local history and the quiet rhythm of the forest. This is the terrain I design for—challenging, unhurried, and entirely authentic.
